essence: One should worship Krishna for one month when the sun is in Libra.
One should offer an uninterrupted, very bright lamp for a month.
The wise person should perform the annual festival on this lunar day.
When performed thus, the deity, being satisfied, bestows the desired object.
One should offer well-cooked food with devotion to the king of the gods.
